review_scope: All four original KVM desktop captures viewed; offline reports passed; Debian available-fix gate passed without exclusions. Raw source/version tracker findings remain and are not all confirmed applicable or resolved.
release_scope: Experimental alpha for isolated VM testing; not for sensitive or production workloads.
account_policy: Upstream passwordless local user autologin and sysmaint setup retained; root locked; no SSH server keys or enabled socket. Configure credentials before persistent use.

update_repository_check.scope: GnuPG verifies the public repository metadata with the pinned shipped key; Tor transport is not tested here

runtime_limits: Physical hardware, Secure Boot and actual VirtualBox runtime unverified
Motion performance on physical GPUs and full login/lock lifecycle not certified
publication_boundary: Owner creates and publishes release metadata. CI stages and hash-verifies actual reviewed files in the owner-created draft; public URLs are checked before enabling the website.
